mapper.select: select sabun, date_format(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, date_format(checkin, '%H:%i:%s') as checkin, date_format(checkout, '%H:%i:%s') as checkout from ta where sabun = #{sabun} and date(day) = curdate()
mapper.insert: insert into ta(sabun, day, checkin) values(#{sabun}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update ta set checkout = now() where sabun = #{sabun} and date(day) = curdate()
mapper.select: select sabun, date_format(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, date_format(checkin, '%H:%i:%s') as checkin, date_format(checkout, '%H:%i:%s') as checkout from ta where sabun = #{sabun} order by day desc

WITH RECURSIVE calendar AS ( SELECT DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01')) AS day UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(day, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM calendar WHERE day < DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-12-31')) ) SELECT s.sabun, s.saname, s.sahire, s.deptno, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) <= '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN (t.day IS NULL OR t.checkin IS NULL OR t.checkout IS NULL) AND sl.use_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absentCount, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND t.checkout IS NOT NULL THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(t.checkout, t.checkin)) / 3600 END), 0 ), 1 ) AS totalWorkTime FROM calendar c JOIN sawon s ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.sabun = s.sabun AND t.day = c.day LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON sl.sabun = s.sabun AND sl.use_date = c.day AND sl.approve = true WHERE DAYOFWEEK(c.day) NOT IN (1, 7) AND c.day <= CURDATE() AND s.deptno = #{deptno} GROUP BY s.sabun, s.saname, s.sahire, s.deptno ORDER BY s.deptno, s.sabun
